# We One Aviation Academy — LLM Index

DGCA-approved pilot training academy in Dwarka, New Delhi, India. Operating since 2009. We teach the DGCA ground subjects for the written examinations behind a Commercial Pilot Licence, and we arrange flight training with partner flying schools in India, the USA, Canada, Australia and South Africa.

We are a ground school and a placement route into flying schools. We do not own aircraft or simulators, we do not employ pilots, and we do not place students into airline jobs — hiring decisions rest with the operator. What we provide is classroom teaching, examination preparation, licence-route planning, interview preparation and career guidance.

## Services

- **DGCA Ground Classes** — Classroom and online teaching for the five DGCA written papers: Air Navigation, Aviation Meteorology, Air Regulations, Technical General and Technical Specific. Roughly six months, with mock tests and live doubt sessions. https://weoneaviation.in/dgca-ground-classes
- **CPL preparation (Commercial Pilot Licence)** — The full route to the licence that lets a pilot be paid to fly: eligibility, the DGCA papers, and placement with a flying school for the 200 hours of flight time. https://weoneaviation.in/courses/cpl
- **PPL guidance (Private Pilot Licence)** — The recreational licence and the usual stepping stone to a CPL, since PPL hours count towards the commercial total. https://weoneaviation.in/ppl-full-form
- **SPL guidance (Student Pilot Licence)** — The first licence in the Indian chain, available from age 16, which permits flight training including solo flying under instructor authorisation. https://weoneaviation.in/student-pilot-license-spl
- **ATPL ground preparation** — Advanced theory for pilots already holding a CPL and building command experience towards airline command. https://weoneaviation.in/courses/atpl
- **RTR (A) preparation** — The Radio Telephone Operator (Restricted) certificate, examined separately from the DGCA papers under the Radio Telephone Operator (Restricted) Certificate and Licence Rules, 2025. https://weoneaviation.in/rtr-a
- **Flight-training placement abroad** — Routes through partner schools in the USA, Canada, Australia and South Africa, with DGCA conversion on return. https://weoneaviation.in/courses
- **Airline interview preparation** — Interview practice, licence-route planning and career guidance for pilots applying to operators. https://weoneaviation.in/airline-preparation-course

## Key Data

Minimum ages, set by the Aircraft Rules, 1937, Schedule II (continued in force by section 43(2) of the Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024):

- Student Pilot Licence (SPL): **16 years** — Section B
- Private Pilot Licence (PPL, Aeroplanes): **17 years** — Section E
- Commercial Pilot Licence (CPL, Aeroplanes): **18 years** — Section J
- Airline Transport Pilot Licence (ATPL, Aeroplanes): **21 years** — Section M

CPL requirements, Schedule II Section J:

- Education: Class 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics from a recognised Board or University — para 1(b)
- Total flight time: **200 hours** as pilot of an aeroplane, flown within the **five years** immediately preceding the application — para 1(e)
- Inside that 200: 100 hours pilot-in-command, 20 hours cross-country as PIC (including one flight of at least 300 nautical miles with full-stop landings at two different aerodromes), 10 hours instrument time (at most 5 on an approved simulator), 5 hours night flying — paras 1(e)(i) to (iv)
- Medical: a certificate of physical fitness from an approved Medical Board — para 1(c)
- Radio: a current Flight Radio Telephone Operator Licence, RTR (A) — para 1(g)
- Skill test: flown for an examiner on the type applied for, within the six months before applying — para 1(h)

DGCA written papers for a CPL: Air Navigation, Aviation Meteorology, Air Regulations, Technical General, Technical Specific. RTR (A) is examined separately. Papers are cleared individually, not in a single sitting.

ATPL experience: the table in Schedule II Section M was amended by G.S.R. 22(E) of 7 January 2020 and again by G.S.R. 731(E) of 10 October 2023. Any hours figure from an older source may be out of date — confirm against the current notified Schedule.

Academy facts: founded 2009; located at C-404, 3rd Floor, Near Ramphal Chowk Road, Palam Extension, Sector-7, Dwarka, New Delhi 110077; phone +91-9355611996; email info.weoneaviation@gmail.com.
